TV.cs.13132.chinese: 啊……是的，我能听到精灵在对我低语……

TV.cs.13134.chinese: 呼……我在水晶球里看见了闪光……这是来自未来的知识碎片！
TV.cs.13134.english: Whoo... I see a flash in the crystal ball... it's a shard of knowledge from the future!

TV.cs.13135.english: Welcome to Welwick's Prophecy... only here can you clearly hear... the voice of the spirits.

TV.cs.13148.chinese: 嘿嘿，开玩笑的……我还没准备好。我今天没什么要教你的。

TV.cs.13175.english: Tomorrow will be a clear, sunny day... perfect weather for the {0}! The event will be held {1}, starting between {2} and {3}. Don't be late!

TV.cs.13181.chinese: 明天的降雪可能会达到几英尺。
TV.cs.13181.english: Tomorrow's snowfall may reach a few feet.

TV.cs.13182.chinese: 明天天气晴朗，风和日丽！
TV.cs.13182.english: Tomorrow will be sunny, with gentle breeze and bright sun!

TV.cs.13183.chinese: 全天都会风和日丽，万里无云。
TV.cs.13183.english: All day there will be gentle breeze and bright sun, without a cloud for ten thousand li.

TV.cs.13185.chinese: 好像有场风暴正在接近。预计将会有雷电。
TV.cs.13185.english: It seems a storm is approaching. Thunder and lightning are expected.

TV.cs.13187.chinese: 部分地区多云，并伴有微风。空气中会有大量花粉！
TV.cs.13187.english: Cloudy in some areas, accompanied by a light breeze. There will be a lot of pollen in the air!

TV.cs.13189.chinese: 今天多云，一整天都会狂风大作。
TV.cs.13189.english: Today is cloudy, and strong winds will blow all day.

TV.cs.13190.chinese: 一整天都要下雪。一定要多穿些，伙计们！
TV.cs.13190.english: It will snow all day. Be sure to wear more, guys!

TV.cs.13191.chinese: 精灵们暴怒异常。显然是某些人打算给他们一些烂贡品……跟精灵开玩笑可不明智！
TV.cs.13191.english: The spirits are unusually furious. Clearly someone intended to give them some rotten offering... joking with the spirits is not wise!

TV.cs.13192.chinese: 精灵今天十分不满。它们会竭尽全力给你捣蛋的。
TV.cs.13192.english: The spirits are very dissatisfied today. They'll do their utmost to make trouble for you.

TV.cs.13193.chinese: 今天精灵们十分气恼。你要走霉运了。
TV.cs.13193.english: Today the spirits are very annoyed. You're going to have bad luck.

TV.cs.13195.chinese: 今天精灵们有些烦躁。你要走霉运了。
TV.cs.13195.english: Today the spirits are somewhat irritable. You're going to have bad luck.

TV.cs.13197.chinese: 精灵们很高兴！今天有人给了他们很好的祭品，他们非常高兴。
TV.cs.13197.english: The spirits are happy! Someone gave them a very good offering today, and they are very pleased.

TV.cs.13198.chinese: 精灵们今天非常开心！他们会尽可能给所有人带来好运的。
TV.cs.13198.english: The spirits are very happy today! They'll bring good luck to everyone as much as possible.

TV.cs.13199.chinese: 精灵们今天的心情很不错。你今天要走运了。
TV.cs.13199.english: The spirits are in a pretty good mood today. You're going to be lucky today.

TV.cs.13200.chinese: 精灵们今天没有任何感情倾向。因此今天的运势全掌握在你手中。
TV.cs.13200.english: The spirits have no emotional leaning today. So today's fortune is entirely in your hands.

TV.cs.13201.chinese: 这可罕见了。精灵们今天很冷漠。
TV.cs.13201.english: This is rare. The spirits are very indifferent today.
